title: Two heritable surfactant kinds in the Marangoni nematic rods: from noise every rod becomes pure A or pure B and its daughters keep the kind (0 switches on 6 runs); when only A drives Marangoni swimming, A's share rises above the neutral twin's on 3/3 seeds (+0.17 to +0.39)
summary: The Marangoni rods of 20261026T0505-c34-nematic-marangoni with two surfactant kinds that the rod makes in proportion to the square of its local composition (majority feedback), from independent white-noise traces of both. By frame 34 every rod is pure A or pure B (fA > 0.8 or < 0.2) and the kind is inherited through fission: along all labkit tracks of 6 runs no rod switches kind, so kinds spread only by division, not by conversion (kindmap_seed0.png: clonal red and blue rods). In the selection arm kind A has the Marangoni coefficient 40 and B has 0; in the neutral twin both have 40 (same seeds and founders). The share of A among pure rods at frame 185 is 0.70, 0.97, 0.38 with selection against 0.31, 0.73, 0.21 neutral (seeds 0, 1, 2), and A parents make 19/25/11 of the persistent splits against B's 10/2/15 (neutral 8/19/4 vs 15/5/16). Founder luck dominates the absolute shares, so this is a sighting: 3 paired seeds over one T=1000 window, no swap of the trait between kinds, no statistics.
